This distribution includes selected Terminal Emulator for Android code from
termux/termux-app v0.118.3, commit
5b657c6adf4304e5198951ce815fe0205dcac29c.

Only selected terminal-emulator and terminal-view Java, resource and test files
are included. The upstream root license identifies that terminal code as an
Apache License 2.0 exception. The original license statement and the full Apache
License 2.0 are included alongside this notice. Original source comments are
retained.

Droy contributors modified the session/client seam for remote-only rendering,
input batching, lifecycle cleanup, localized selection labels and selection
handle tinting. The local process/JNI implementation is not included.
Modification year: 2026.

Repository: https://github.com/termux/termux-app
Original project: https://github.com/jackpal/Android-Terminal-Emulator
